mapper.select: SELECT fr.fx_rate_id AS "fxRateId", bc.currency_id AS "baseCurrencyId", bc.currency_code AS "baseCurrencyCode", bc.exponent AS "baseCurrencyExponent", qc.currency_id AS "quoteCurrencyId", qc.currency_code AS "quoteCurrencyCode", qc.exponent AS "quoteCurrencyExponent", fr.rate_date AS "rateDate", fr.rate, fr.source FROM fx_rate fr JOIN currency bc ON bc.currency_id = fr.base_currency_id JOIN currency qc ON qc.currency_id = fr.quote_currency_id WHERE fr.base_currency_id = #{baseCurrencyId} AND fr.quote_currency_id = #{quoteCurrencyId} AND fr.rate_date = #{rateDate}
